4.description: The item introduces the 2025 budget, outlining initial investments, pressures from growth and inflation, and proposed adjustments. Administration suggests a $2 million investment income increase, potentially setting the property tax requirement at 5.2%.

chips.text: Councillor Davies praised the budget's start, noting it was "reduced before we even kicked off."
Saskatoon's population grew by 46,000 residents since 2018, impacting service needs.
